tools.name: prodigi_list_orders
tools.description: List print orders of this Prodigi account, newest first (sorted by order id, descending), with status stage, items, shipments and charges. Filter by status, creation time, Prodigi order ids or your own merchant references. Paging: top (1-100, default 10) and skip; the reply has has_more and next_ski

tools.name: prodigi_get_order
tools.description: One print order by Prodigi order id: status stage and per-step details (asset download, production, shipping), issues, charges, shipments with tracking, recipient, items with print assets and costs, metadata. The webhook callbackUrl is reduced to its host. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: prodigi_get_order_actions
tools.description: Which changes Prodigi still allows on an order right now (cancel, change recipient details, change shipping method, change metadata), each with isAvailable (Yes/No). Only reports availability; it changes nothing. GET /orders/{id}/actions.

tools.name: prodigi_create_quote
tools.description: Price a print order WITHOUT creating or charging one: item cost, shipping (per shipping method, or all methods when none is given), branding inserts, tax and total, with carrier, fulfilment lab and unit costs, in the account's currency unless currency_code is set. Each item needs a sku, copies and t

tools.name: prodigi_get_product
tools.description: Details of one Prodigi product by SKU: description, dimensions, the attribute names and allowed values (size, wrap, colour...), print areas and which are required, and variants with the countries each ships to and the print-area pixel sizes. Use it to build valid quote requests. GET /products/{sku}.

tools.name: prodigi_get_spine_width
tools.description: Calculate the spine width in mm of a book product for a page count (for cover artwork). A pure calculation: nothing is created or charged. POST /products/spine.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prodigi_get_order, prodigi_create_quote, prodigi_get_spine_width · Public sink: prodigi_get_order, prodigi_create_quote, prodigi_get_spine_width.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prodigi_get_order, prodigi_create_quote, prodigi_get_spine_width · Public sink: prodigi_get_order, prodigi_create_quote, prodigi_get_spine_width

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
